sample_unit: irregularities recorded during first year of online adaptive radiotherapy
unlisted_practices: Updating a prospective FMEA risk analysis with documented real-world irregularities after one year of clinical use

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates clinical experience and irregularities during a 1-year real deployment of an AI-driven online adaptive radiotherapy system to re-evaluate and update a Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) risk analysis and mitigation strategies.

primary.practice: prospective risk analysis and post-implementation failure mode updating
